mentions.name: Langsam
mentions.description: An AST-walking interpreter for a personal LISP dialect, written in C. It is the foundation of a planned toolchain: a low-level statically typed language (Schnell) implemented as a library with JIT compilation, a rewritten fast bytecode interpreter, and eventually a small OS (Oben) bootstrapped on top of an assembly-language Forth dialect (Grund) on QEMU, Raspberry Pi Zero 2W, or custom FPGA hardware.
